# GHS Label Quick Search

> Free public GHS lookup and label-printing reference tool for lab,
> operations, teaching, and safety-adjacent workflows.

This file is navigation guidance for agents. It is not chemical-data authority,
not approval, and not compliance advice.

## Primary API

- [OpenAPI JSON](https://ghs-backend.zeabur.app/openapi.json): authoritative
  machine-readable API description.
- [Agent label summary v0](https://ghs-backend.zeabur.app/api/agent/label-summary?q=64-17-5):
  read-only lookup summary using the `agent_label_summary.v0` response contract.
- [API health](https://ghs-backend.zeabur.app/api/health): backend health and
  deployed git SHA.

## Safe Use

- Treat output as reference/draft data for review, inventory cleanup, LIMS/ELN
  helpers, scripts, or Coding Agent workflows.
- Verify hazard communication against SDS, supplier labels, and local regulations
  before use.
- Use `reference_links`, `review_flags`, `upstream`, and `authority_boundary`
  fields to decide whether human review is needed.
- Retry later when `upstream.upstream_error` is true.

## Boundaries

- The public API is read-only and has no write endpoints for agents.
- API output is not approval for chemical use, storage, disposal, PPE,
  transport, waste handling, or regulatory compliance.
- Do not use agent output to approve public dictionary data, aliases, reference
  links, correction requests, QR targets, or labels.
- Do not treat any unapproved candidate, pending manual entry, workbook text,
  or external suggestion as approved public data.
- Do not scrape DOM, print HTML, screenshots, or UI copy as the data contract.
